cases.name: verified_dense_lambda_min
cases.note: Baseline. A correct lambda_min enclosure on a 6x6 dense symmetric operator.

cases.name: verified_composed_bundle
cases.note: A temple certificate discharging its gap hypothesis via a referenced count certificate.

cases.name: abstain_enclosure_shrunk
cases.note: The witness does not support the claim: a point claim tighter than the re-derived enclosure.

cases.name: abstain_enclosure_shifted
cases.note: Enclosure moved off the true eigenvalue; re-derivation does not support it.

cases.name: abstain_unsealed_mutation
cases.note: Body mutated without re-sealing. The content hash must catch this before any mathematics runs.

cases.name: abstain_witness_tampered
cases.note: Witness vector replaced with zeros; the claim no longer follows from it.

cases.name: abstain_operator_substituted
cases.note: A valid certificate checked against a different operator must not verify.

cases.name: abstain_unknown_rule
cases.note: Unknown rule names are refused, never ignored.

cases.name: abstain_garbage_input
cases.note: Malformed input abstains rather than crashing.

cases.name: abstain_dependency_missing
cases.note: Broken dependency: the temple certificate's referenced count certificate is absent.

cases.name: abstain_forged_cycle
cases.note: A cycle, buildable only by lying about content hashes. Traversal refuses regardless.

cases.name: abstain_self_reference
cases.note: Self-reference is a cycle of length one.
